title: Warm Kenyan Ugali Casserole
description: A fermented, crumbly, and cozy Kenyan dish featuring rosemary, cooked in a bain-marie for a low-glycemic-friendly meal, this casserole is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the cornmeal, water, and salt, then let it sit for 24 hours to ferment.
After fermentation, stir in the rosemary, melted butter, sour cream, eggs, and grated cheddar.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and place it in a larger baking dish filled with water to create a bain-marie.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional rosemary sprigs if desired.
